definitions.name: S0B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'XS' BIND XS LENGTH 'LN' BIND XS LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET XS LN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a Vector of numbers.

definitions.name: S0B.SPJOIN
definitions.note: Join a Vector of Strings with single spaces.

definitions.name: S0B.CAP1
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Upper-case the first letter of a word.

definitions.name: S0B.SUMS
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ S0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Record name -> sum of amounts from a Vector of [name amount] entries.

solutions.ledger.debtors: S0B.SUMS 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND E I GET
solutions.ledger.top_name: S0B.SUMS 'R' BIND R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND R KEYS I GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: ' ' TOKENIZE TALLY 'R' BIND R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND R KEYS I GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.prose.longest: ' ' TOKENIZE 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V S0B.MEDIAN 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D 0 D SUB MAX S0B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.mode: SORT TALLY 'R' BIND R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND R KEYS I GET
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'K' BIND V K TAKE V 1 DROP K TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.trimmed: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 2 SUB 'K' BIND S 1 DROP -1 DROP S0B.SUM K DIV
